revised_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: TripPet iOS achievement medal raster art candidate for achievement_medal_travel_tier_006, later converted into a transparent 768x768 app asset
Primary request: Create one premium collectible travel achievement medal for tier 6, GOLD rank, based on the Chinese title concept "环球旅人" (global traveler whose achievement comes from a powerful backer). The image itself must contain no text, no numbers, no labels.
Input image role: the attached rank-medal screenshot is a reference for progressive border complexity only; do not copy its shield shape, numbers, dark UI, text, or exact design.
Scene/backdrop: perfectly flat solid #ff00ff chroma-key background for background removal. The background must be one uniform #ff00ff color with no shadows, gradients, texture, reflections, floor plane, transparency checkerboard, or lighting variation.
Subject: exactly one centered circular collectible medal, full object visible with generous padding. Tier 6 is the final and most extravagant circular medal: dominant radiant gold rim, thick layered gold metal, largest symmetrical side wings, elaborate crown-like top ornament, rich lower pedestal flourish, gold rays and sparkling white-gold highlights. It should clearly outrank tier 5 while still fitting the same six-medal set. Inside the circle is one compact funny center object: a cream-gold travel suitcase standing triumphantly on one tiny blue-green globe trophy pedestal, with a large abstract golden backing halo behind it like a powerful patron or "靠山". The backing halo is not a person, not a hand, not a face, and not text; it is a raised gold arch silhouette behind the suitcase. The suitcase remains dominant.
Style/medium: polished mobile game collectible, semi-3D hand-painted enamel pin / toy medal hybrid, refined and readable at small iOS size, playful but premium, crisp transparent-asset silhouette, not photorealistic.
Composition/framing: base circular size consistent with a six-medal set; final-tier outer decoration is the largest and brightest, with safe padding; full medal visible, no cropping; centered symmetrical front view.
Lighting/mood: triumphant global luxury, gold rank, strongest celebratory glow in the set, prestigious but still playful.
Color palette: radiant gold rim, deep gold metal, warm cream-gold suitcase, blue-green globe pedestal, white-gold sparkles, tiny deep teal shadows. Do not use #ff00ff anywhere in the medal or subject.
Materials/textures: glossy enamel, polished radiant gold metal, tiny globe trophy, abstract gold halo, beveled rim, lacquered toy surfaces, clean edges. No paper texture.
Text: none.
Constraints: one medal only; no letters, no numbers, no Chinese, no labels, no watermark, no people, no animals, no real hands, no face in the halo, no detailed map, no compass, no leaves, no ticket, no camera, no neck pillow, no blanket, no airplane, no seat, no drink cup, no rocket, no fireball, no explosion, no smoke cloud, no coins, no money pile, no confetti, no crown as a separate object outside the medal, no shield badge, no black background, no cast shadow, no contact shadow, no reflection, do not create multiple medals.
title: 环球旅人
concept: 金色夸张圆形加强冠饰侧翼底托和光效，中心为环球旅人旅行箱
integration_note: TripPet 1.0.8 travel medal redesign: six-level white, green, blue, purple, orange, gold rank progression; source PNG copied byte-identically to app-facing @3x PNG.
